title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
sourceTitle: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
synopsis: A cupboard under the stairs. A letter brought by owl. A platform between nines and tens. You're a wizard, Harry.

nodes.text: Hundreds, in the chimney, in the kitchen, under the door.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.

nodes.text: You return next year for more. The lessons get harder. Hermione, somehow, also gets sharper. Ron, somehow, also.
You and Ron and Hermione, for seven years, are inseparable. The friendship outlasts the school.
You realize, over years, that Dumbledore was setting you up to learn slowly. Some of it was kind. Some of it was, less so. You forgive him, mostly, late.
